model: LightGBM binary (+GIS), trained on 2019-24 sampled cell-days (all fire cell-days + 3% of others), GFS weather of the issue day; weak divisions (< 1000 own training fire cell-days): own x3 + neighbours x1
target: fire (VIIRS S-NPP/NOAA-20/NOAA-21, type 0, seasonal rules) in the square on day +1 or +2

live_rule.quiet_def: no type-0 detection within 10 cells (5 km) on days t-6..t
live_rule.pool: statewide by calibrated %; 35% of the pool to quiet squares
live_rule.changed: 2026-10-21: quiet share 0.25 -> 0.35 (owner's choice from the live quiet-share curve); k re-bisected on 2026 (calibrated on 2025)
